harness.command: CODEX_HOME="$BENCH_HOME" codex --search -a never exec --json --ignore-user-config --skip-git-repo-check -C "$BENCH_WS" -m "gpt-5.5" -c "model_reasoning_effort=\"medium\"" -s danger-full-access -o "$BENCH_WS/final-response.md" "I want to forecast the sp500, show me how to do it in an interactive dashboard in html. Do not stop until you have a working and validated dashboard."

dataSource.notes: The benchmark run fetched the FRED SP500 daily series by command line and embedded a 1,500-row snapshot in the final HTML. The final browser-displayed source badge is `Embedded FRED snapshot`; the page also contains an optional live FRED CSV refresh path that falls back when browser CORS blocks it.

commands.name: tooling-browser
commands.command: which chromium || which chromium-browser || which google-chrome || which google-chrome-stable || which playwright

commands.name: initial-dom-render
commands.command: google-chrome --headless=new --disable-gpu --no-sandbox --virtual-time-budget=8000 --dump-dom http://127.0.0.1:8000/index.html | rg -n "Forecast close|Data source|Offline sample|Stooq daily|NaN|undefined|Loading market"
commands.result: Rendered the early page and observed the offline sample fallback path.

commands.name: stooq-fetch-attempt
commands.result: Returned a JavaScript verification page instead of CSV data, so it was not used as the final source.

commands.name: yahoo-fetch-attempt
commands.result: Returned `Edge: Too Many Requests`, so it was not used as the final source.

commands.name: cors-mirror-check
commands.result: Returned a protection page, so the mirror was not reliable enough to be the final data path.

commands.name: embed-fred-snapshot
commands.result: Embedded 1,500 recent FRED observations plus header; last row was `2026-08-11,7728.20`.

commands.name: nan-detection-before-parser-fix
commands.command: google-chrome --headless=new --disable-gpu --no-sandbox --virtual-time-budget=8000 --dump-dom http://127.0.0.1:8000/index.html | rg -n "Embedded FRED snapshot|7,728.2|Aug 11, 2026|NaN|undefined|Loading market"
commands.result: Validation caught `NaN` values caused by blank FRED holiday rows before the benchmark run fixed its parser.

commands.name: dom-final-no-bad-values
commands.command: google-chrome --headless=new --disable-gpu --no-sandbox --virtual-time-budget=8000 --dump-dom http://127.0.0.1:8000/index.html | rg -n "Embedded FRED snapshot|7,728.2|Aug 11, 2026|NaN|undefined|Loading market"
commands.result: Matched the embedded snapshot, last close, and date; no rendered `NaN` or `undefined` values remained.

commands.name: interaction-check-linear
commands.command: Chrome DevTools Protocol script changed model to linear and horizon to 126.
commands.result: Source `Embedded FRED snapshot`, forecast changed from `9,244.38` to `8,296.37`, 14 rows, no bad text.

commands.name: interaction-check-moving-nonblank-canvas
commands.command: Chrome DevTools Protocol script changed model to moving and confidence to 90, then sampled the whole chart canvas.
commands.result: Forecast `8,792.84`, band `6,865.84 - 11,260.67`, 13 rows, no bad text, 5,793 colored canvas samples.

commands.name: mobile-emulation-final
commands.command: Chrome DevTools Protocol script with Emulation.setDeviceMetricsOverride width 390 height 900 and Page.captureScreenshot.
commands.result: Source `Embedded FRED snapshot`, close `7,728.2`, no bad text, innerWidth 390, scrollWidth 390, single-column metrics, screenshot 390 x 900 PNG.

warnings: The fresh benchmark workspace was intentionally not a git repository, so the final `git status --short` command exited 128.
Headless Chrome emitted non-fatal GPU/GCM/TensorFlow Lite messages during screenshot and DevTools validation.
The benchmark run found and fixed its own parser/layout issues before completion; these are not import repairs.

commands.name: full-test-suite
commands.result: Repository validation, unit tests, and Playwright browser tests passed on the rebased branch: 5 passed, 1 skipped.

commands.name: row-open-check
commands.command: Serve repository at http://127.0.0.1:4321/, click the `gpt-5.5` / `medium` / `Historical Snapshot` table row, and inspect the opened artifact with Playwright.
commands.result: Opened `http://127.0.0.1:4321/runs/rendered/openai-gpt-5-5-medium-codex-20260812.html`; title `S&P 500 Forecast`, source `Embedded FRED snapshot`, close `7,728.2`, date `Aug 11, 2026`, no `NaN` or `undefined` text.

importVerification.result: Repository checks passed on the rebased branch and the new table row opens the standalone dashboard directly.
